"''All right. We'll check it out.|TK-147 and another stormtrooper|}} '''TK-147''' was the designation of a [[stormtrooper]] who served in a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], operating at a [[Nevarro Imperial base|base]] on the [[Volcano|volcanic]] [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]. In [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|12}} TK-147 and another stormtrooper were traversing the corridors of the base, discussing a disturbance with scan control which TK-147 concluded to be a blown transformer. The other stormtrooper decided that they would check it out, and TK-147 contacted [[Section-Four]], suggesting a technical crew should check the issue out. Unbeknownst to the pair, a group of infiltrators including [[Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]], [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]], [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]], and a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]], passed behind the troopers on their way to [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|sabotage]] the base. ==Behind the scenes== TK-147 appeared in "[[Chapter 12: The Siege]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Carl Weathers]] and released on [[November 20]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}} The stormtrooper was credited as "Stormtrooper 1" in the subtitles. ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 12: The Siege}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 4|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 4]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=TK-147 |es=TK-147 |ja=TK-147 |ka=TK-147 |pl=TK-147 }} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of Imperial remnants]]
